item.title: The legendary New York modern dance theatre returns to Brussels - We Love Brussels
item.description: Dance aficionados, take note: the legendary New York modern dance company finally returns to Brussels with two brand-new artistic programs this October. Blending heritage and creation, Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater's comeback to the Belgian capital stands as one of the major choreographic events of the 2026 fall season. The prestigious New York company will perform on the stage of Forest National from 1 to 4 October.

item.title: Vive Boesmans Recital at La Monnaie - We Love Brussels
item.description: Philippe Boesmans would have turned 90 in 2026. To mark the occasion, various Brussels institutions are coming together to honour his memory with a series of concerts and events. In February and March, the Boesmans Wave 26 will see La Monnaie, Flagey, the Brussels Philharmonic, the Brussels Conservatory, the Royal Academy of Belgium, Collège Belgique, the Royal Library, and the Klara Festival join forces to present concerts, recitals, masterclasses, and talks.

item.title: Brussels Music Agenda: Concerts, festivals and music events in March - We Love Brussels
item.description: Days are getting longer, nights are getting wilder and March welcomes plenty of international artists on tour. Kesha, Andrea Bocelli, CMAT, UB40, Suede, Lara Fabian, Jade or Wu-Tang are some of the artists visiting us, a clear sign that Belgium is open to all kinds of music! We have collected all the information by style in our dedicated monthly article.

item.title: Best of Brussels in March - We Love Brussels
item.description: Over the past few days we’ve been strolling around the city and enjoying the relaxed, sunny vibes. As always, we bring you a list of best things to do in Brussels this spring.
